propositions: LLMRunnerError raised for step-budget exhaustion does not match the except clause catching only UnretryableOutputError, so recovery is unreachable
The bounded per-criterion recovery mechanism is designed to narrow tasks and isolate criteria in fresh agentic history but cannot engage when budget exhaustion occurs

A new typed exception LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) must be raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to make budget exhaustion identifiable by type rather than message or diagnostic shape
CompletionAgentStep.run must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover to enable the recovery machinery for budget-exhausted steps
The truncation path (UnretryableOutputError + _is_token_exhaustion) must retain its current behavior and route to recovery unchanged
When recovery fails, the original budget diagnostic must be preserved on failure_diagnostic so counters are available to the caller
